See the formula ↓

How the calculation works

Reading minutes = Pages × Words per page ÷ Words per minute

A worked example

Twenty pages at about 300 words each contain approximately 6,000 words. At 200 words per minute, the first-pass reading estimate is 30 minutes, or half an hour.

Before you use the result

Words per page varies widely with formatting and subject matter. Use a sample from the actual text rather than treating the default as a measured average. This estimate excludes note-taking, problem solving, pauses and rereading. Technical material may need a different measured speed from ordinary prose.

Results display to two decimal places unless stated otherwise. Read our calculation methodology for scope and limitations.

Frequently asked questions

How can I estimate words per page?

Count words on a few representative pages and average those counts. Avoid pages dominated by figures or blank space.

Is the default speed a recommendation?

No. It is an editable example value. Use a speed measured on similar material.
